controls.input_condition: An entity is assessed for UK ETS aircraft-operator status
controls.expected_action: Require both an in-scope aviation activity and full-scope annual emissions above the threshold applicable to its operator class
controls.risk_prevented: Applying obligations using activity or emissions alone

controls.input_condition: A commercial air transport operator is assessed for a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Treat it as not an aircraft operator if it operated fewer than 243 full-scope flights in each of 3 consecutive 4-month periods or emitted less than 10,000 tCO2 from full-scope flights
controls.risk_prevented: Applying UK ETS duties below the commercial threshold

controls.input_condition: A non-commercial air transport operator is assessed
controls.expected_action: Treat it as not an aircraft operator when annual full-scope emissions are below 1,000 tCO2
controls.risk_prevented: Using the commercial threshold for non-commercial activity

controls.input_condition: A fixed-wing or rotary-wing flight uses an aircraft below the mass boundary
controls.expected_action: Exclude the flight when certified maximum take-off mass is below 5,700 kg
controls.risk_prevented: Counting expressly excluded small-aircraft flights

controls.input_condition: A flight is military, search-and-rescue, firefighting, humanitarian or another Schedule 1 excluded class
controls.expected_action: Exclude it from aviation activity and full-scope calculations
controls.risk_prevented: Including excluded public-interest flights

controls.input_condition: A flight departs a UK aerodrome
controls.expected_action: Include it when it arrives in the UK, eligible EEA territory, Gibraltar, Switzerland or a covered offshore structure, subject to exclusions
controls.risk_prevented: Dropping an in-scope departure route

controls.input_condition: A flight arrives in the UK from Gibraltar
controls.expected_action: Include it as aviation activity even though the general route rule is departure-based
controls.risk_prevented: Missing the specific Gibraltar arrival rule

controls.input_condition: Threshold emissions and compliance emissions are calculated
controls.expected_action: Keep full-scope flights for threshold testing distinct from UK ETS aviation activities used for reportable emissions
controls.risk_prevented: Using one route universe for two different tests

controls.input_condition: Eurocontrol SET is used for threshold or emissions calculations
controls.expected_action: Use the most accurate actual ground flight-track distance for each aerodrome pair
controls.risk_prevented: Understating or overstating emissions with proxy distance

controls.input_condition: SET distance inputs are prepared
controls.expected_action: Do not apply great-circle distance plus 95 km indiscriminately to all flights
controls.risk_prevented: Using a method the official guidance says is inappropriate for SET threshold assessment

controls.input_condition: An entity becomes an aircraft operator
controls.expected_action: Submit an emissions monitoring plan application within 42 days
controls.risk_prevented: Operating without timely monitoring-plan approval

controls.input_condition: The 42-day monitoring-plan deadline cannot be met or was missed
controls.expected_action: Contact the regulator and explain the delay in the application form
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting a late application without an evidenced reason

controls.input_condition: A regulator application is treated as duly made
controls.expected_action: Require all requested information, submission of the form and payment of any required fee
controls.risk_prevented: Starting the determination clock on an incomplete application

controls.input_condition: A monitoring-plan application is duly made
controls.expected_action: Expect regulator determination within 2 months unless a longer period is agreed
controls.risk_prevented: Treating an open application as approved or indefinitely pending

controls.input_condition: A regulator issues an emissions monitoring plan
controls.expected_action: Monitor and report in accordance with its conditions and supporting procedures
controls.risk_prevented: Using an unapproved monitoring method

controls.input_condition: A significant monitoring-plan change is proposed
controls.expected_action: Apply through METS at least 14 days before the change, or as soon as possible afterwards when advance application is impracticable
controls.risk_prevented: Implementing a significant change without variation

controls.input_condition: A non-significant monitoring-plan change is planned or occurs
controls.expected_action: Notify the regulator through METS by 31 December of that year
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving minor plan changes undisclosed

controls.input_condition: Annual aviation monitoring is configured
controls.expected_action: Use 1 January through 31 December for each scheme year
controls.risk_prevented: Mixing aviation monitoring with another reporting period

controls.input_condition: A scheme year has ended
controls.expected_action: Submit the prior-year annual emissions report by 31 March
controls.risk_prevented: Late aviation emissions reporting

controls.input_condition: Prior-year aviation emissions are established
controls.expected_action: Surrender allowances equal to those emissions by 30 April
controls.risk_prevented: Missing the annual surrender deadline

controls.input_condition: An aviation allocation is assessed for a period beginning 1 January 2026
controls.expected_action: Assign no aviation free allocation for that allocation period
controls.risk_prevented: Carrying 2021-2025 entitlements into 2026

controls.input_condition: No aviation activity occurred or thresholds were not exceeded in a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Set monitoring, reporting and surrender obligations to none for that year
controls.risk_prevented: Retaining obligations during an exempt year

controls.input_condition: An operator says it had no activity or remained below thresholds, or Eurocontrol data shows exemption
controls.expected_action: Allow the regulator to mark the METS reporting requirement as exempt and require prompt challenge of an incorrect status
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving an exemption unrecorded or uncorrected

controls.input_condition: An operator seeks simplified reporting instead of an independent verifier
controls.expected_action: Allow the route when full-scope emissions are below 25,000 tCO2 per year or UK ETS aviation-activity emissions are below 3,000 tCO2 per year
controls.risk_prevented: Applying simplified reporting above both thresholds

controls.input_condition: Simplified reporting is selected
controls.expected_action: Obtain a draft emissions report from the Eurocontrol Support Facility
controls.risk_prevented: Creating a simplified report without the prescribed source

controls.input_condition: ETS-SF data is received
controls.expected_action: Compare it against internal flight records before populating METS
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting unreviewed third-party flight data

controls.input_condition: The ETS-SF draft conflicts with internal records
controls.expected_action: Ask Eurocontrol to correct errors before using the data for simplified reporting
controls.risk_prevented: Knowingly reporting inaccurate ETS-SF data

controls.input_condition: An operator plans to use ETS-SF simplified reporting
controls.expected_action: Consider requesting the draft report in October so corrections can be completed before 31 March
controls.risk_prevented: Discovering data errors too late to correct

controls.input_condition: An operator seeks to qualify as a small emitter for SET use
controls.expected_action: Require fewer than 243 full-scope flights in each of 3 consecutive 4-month periods or annual emissions below 25,000 tCO2
controls.risk_prevented: Using SET without small-emitter eligibility

controls.input_condition: A small emitter uses the Eurocontrol SET
controls.expected_action: Populate it with the operator's own flight data
controls.risk_prevented: Substituting unrelated or incomplete activity data

controls.input_condition: SET is used to calculate aviation emissions
controls.expected_action: Require verification by an accredited independent verifier
controls.risk_prevented: Treating SET output as self-verifying

controls.input_condition: An annual aviation report is prepared
controls.expected_action: Require an independent verifier unless the operator is eligible for and chooses simplified reporting
controls.risk_prevented: Skipping assurance without a lawful simplified route

controls.input_condition: An independent verifier is appointed
controls.expected_action: Require UKAS accreditation covering the regulated aviation activity
controls.risk_prevented: Using a verifier outside its accredited scope

controls.input_condition: An operator and verifier want a virtual site visit for the previous scheme year
controls.expected_action: Apply with supporting evidence by 28 February and comply with any regulator conditions
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a virtual visit as an automatic entitlement

controls.input_condition: A verifier assesses a small emitter
controls.expected_action: Allow no site visit only when the verifier's risk analysis supports that conclusion
controls.risk_prevented: Waiving a site visit without risk assessment

controls.input_condition: Verification is complete or simplified reporting is ready
controls.expected_action: Do not mark the annual report formally submitted until the operator submits the report and required assurance material to the regulator in METS
controls.risk_prevented: Confusing verifier return with regulatory submission

controls.input_condition: A verified aviation report is amended
controls.expected_action: Return it to the verifier for re-verification before regulatory submission
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting changed figures under an obsolete opinion

controls.input_condition: No compliant verified annual report is submitted by 31 March
controls.expected_action: Route to regulator determination, recoverable costs and possible civil penalty
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a missing report as zero or accepted

controls.input_condition: A compliant independently verified report is submitted by 31 March
controls.expected_action: Record the verified figure in the AOHA as soon as the report is submitted to the regulator
controls.risk_prevented: Delaying authoritative emissions recording

controls.input_condition: A compliant simplified report is submitted
controls.expected_action: Record emissions between 1 and 30 April after regulator review
controls.risk_prevented: Treating simplified data as immediately verified

controls.input_condition: The regulator issues a determination for late or erroneous reporting
controls.expected_action: Record the determined figure in the AOHA within one month of the notice
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving the compliance account without the authoritative figure

controls.input_condition: An operator intends to make a sustainable-aviation-fuel emissions reduction claim
controls.expected_action: Vary the emissions monitoring plan and attach the required claim methodology before making the claim
controls.risk_prevented: Claiming SAF reductions under an unapproved method

controls.input_condition: Fuel is included in an emissions reduction claim
controls.expected_action: Require eligible SAF purchased during the scheme year or in the 3 months before it began
controls.risk_prevented: Claiming ineligible fuel or an out-of-window purchase

controls.input_condition: A SAF claim is submitted
controls.expected_action: Require delivery to an aerodrome fuelling system or aircraft before 31 March, no sale or benefit in another scheme, and independent verification
controls.risk_prevented: Double counting, undelivered fuel or unverified reductions

controls.input_condition: The regulator is not satisfied that SAF claim criteria are met
controls.expected_action: Reject part or all of the claim and determine aviation emissions for the scheme year
controls.risk_prevented: Retaining an unsupported emissions reduction

controls.input_condition: Data supports an aviation annual emissions report
controls.expected_action: Retain relevant data and information for at least 10 years from report submission
controls.risk_prevented: Losing the audit trail before regulatory review

controls.input_condition: A verification report recommends improvements or identifies monitoring-plan non-conformities
controls.expected_action: Generate and submit a verifier-recommended improvement report
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving verifier findings without a remediation process

controls.input_condition: An aviation improvement report is required
controls.expected_action: Submit it by 30 June in the year the annual report was submitted
controls.risk_prevented: Missing the improvement-report deadline

controls.input_condition: An improvement report responds to findings
controls.expected_action: Describe how and when non-conformities will be addressed and recommendations implemented
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting a report without actions or timing

controls.input_condition: An operator rejects a recommendation as ineffective or unreasonably costly
controls.expected_action: Explain the reason and provide supporting evidence
controls.risk_prevented: Dismissing verifier recommendations without evidence

controls.input_condition: An operator received allowances for a year in which it was not an aircraft operator
controls.expected_action: Return the allowances
controls.risk_prevented: Retaining an allocation without eligibility

controls.input_condition: A 2024 or 2025 aviation entitlement exceeded that year's aviation emissions
controls.expected_action: Return the excess allowances
controls.risk_prevented: Keeping over-allocated historical aviation allowances
